addins.name: GitPane
addins.description: Visual Git integration for the Clarion IDE. A dockable pane providing commit, push, pull, branch management, stash, history, and merge conflict resolution directly within Clarion.
addins.author: msarson

addins.name: Flatten Code
addins.description: Flattens Clarion line continuations (|) into single logical lines. Collapses adjacent string literals joined with & and restores caret position. Available via Ctrl+Shift+F, Edit → Format menu, and editor context menus — only shown when the caret is inside a continuation block.
addins.author: msarson

addins.name: List Format Parser
addins.description: Parses and cleans the FORMAT() attribute of a Clarion LIST control. Provides 'Parse List Format' in the context menu, 'Clean List Format' and 'Format FROM Selections' in Edit → Format, 'Copy FROM as CASE' / 'Copy FROM as CHOOSE' in the Edit menu and context menus, and 'Queue → Format Generator' to build FORMAT() strings from QUEUE/FILE declarations — all commands are condition-gated to the relevant attribute.
addins.author: msarson

addins.name: Clarion LSP
addins.description: Shared Clarion language server (LSP) infrastructure for the Clarion IDE. Manages the Node.js language server lifecycle and exposes IClarionLanguageClient for other addins to consume — providing hover, go to definition, go to implementation, find references, workspace symbols, rename, code completion, signature help, diagnostics, document highlight, folding, selection ranges, code actions, code lens, document formatting, and live unsaved-buffer sync across Clarion source files.
addins.author: msarson

addins.name: Clarion Markdown Editor
addins.description: Markdown file viewer and editor for the Clarion IDE: split-pane live preview, syntax highlighting, tabbed multi-file editing, dark mode sync, and load-from-URL for previewing remote READMEs (with a public API other addins can call).
addins.author: msarson

addins.name: Clarion CSV Editor
addins.description: CSV / TSV viewer and editor for the Clarion IDE: a spreadsheet-style grid (Tabulator + WebView2) with column sorting, find/filter, undo/redo, Excel-style range selection and TSV copy/paste, add/delete rows and columns, double-click column rename, delimiter auto-detect with a picker, and faithful CSV round-trip (line endings, trailing newline and quoting preserved). Requires the WebView2 runtime.
addins.author: msarson

addins.name: Clarion Transformer
addins.description: Transforms Clarion code using Claude AI (Anthropic API). Takes the selected code block in the editor — or the active PROCEDURE if nothing is selected — and applies a user-defined protocol file (.md). Ships two fixed menu commands, each bound to its own profile: 'Transform to ABC' (legacy file I/O to ABC migration) and 'Refactor' (cleanup of existing ABC code). Supports per-profile Old/New code backups, optional explanatory comments, and configurable re-indentation.
addins.author: asantarelli
